scope: Theorem 3.1 (Conditional sweep moment estimate) of the manuscript “Conditional coordinate sweeps and analytic transfer” (preprints/Conditional-coordinate-sweeps-and-analytic-transfer-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 50b927834abd484c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a power of two R ≥ 2, a positive integer q, and z∗ > 0 such that every grid and every family H of prescribed disjoint trajectories defined above satisfy, for every z ∈ [0, z∗] and every λ ⊢ s − h, log TH λ ≤ −c(s)F(λ) + e(s)h log s − C(H). (5) Here a zero moment gives −∞. Use parameters a = 1 100 , c0 = e0 = a 100 , c(s) = c0 + 1 √ log s , e(s) = e0 − 1 √ log s . The empty diagram has dimension one. If h = s, the remaining bijection is the unique empty bijection and its moment is one. The assertion also includes the one-dimensional trivial representation for every h.
